periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downward toward the muzzle.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering at the inferior margin, resulting in a teardrop-shaped pixel distribution.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending across approximately one-third of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semicircular curvature at the apex of the ears.
